newsitem.title: POLAND: GDANSKI SURGES ON STRONG JULY EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: GDANSKI SURGES ON STRONG JULY EARNINGS.

text.p: Poland's Bank Gdanski SA rose the daily maximum 10 percent on Tuesday to 41.9 zlotys, buoyed by Monday's news July net profit had risen to 9.8 million from 7.3 million zlotys, traders said.

Most of the main market's top gainers on Tuesday were firms showing strong July earnings, such as Zasada , up 9.4 percent. Buying after price fixing for both Zasada and Gdanski was strong enough for players to have their bids reduced.
Bank WBK , up nine percent, also jumped on strong earnings but was also reacting to significant falls in recent days, traders said. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
